newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN ELECT TO BAT AGAINST AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN ELECT TO BAT AGAINST AUSTRALIA.

text.p: Pakistan captain Wasim Akram won the toss and elected to bat against Australia in a World Series limited overs match at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on Thursday.
Australia named Darren Lehmann as a replacement batsman for opener Mark Waugh, who was ruled out with a hamstring strain.
Pakistan and West Indies have already qualified for the best-of-three final in the triangular tournament.
Australia - Greg Blewett, Mark Taylor (captain), Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Stuart Law, Darren Lehmann, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Andrew Bichel, Anthony Stuart, Glenn McGrath, Paul Reiffel (12th man).
Pakistan - Aamir Sohail, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Zahoor Elahi, Ijaz Ahmed, Mohammad Wasim, Wasim Akram, Moin Khan, Shahid Afridi, Saqlain Mushtaq, Mushtaq Ahmed, Waqar Younis, Shahid Nazir (12th man)
